observations.observation: Reuters reported that Solidigm held meetings with investment banks competing for IPO roles during the week of Sep. 21–25. Anonymous sources described a possible IPO as early as the following year, up to $150 billion valuation and $15 billion proceeds; Reuters said timing and size remained early-stage and subject to change.
observations.event_time: Week of 2026-09-21; exact meeting dates not reported
observations.publication_time: 2026-09-25 12:47 PM (Reuters page display; timezone not stated)
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The estimates and meetings were attributed to unnamed sources; neither an IPO filing nor firm terms were reported. The article says the company had not confirmed specific plans.

observations.observation: The Sep. 4 SK hynix 6-K said Solidigm was reviewing competitiveness measures but had made no determinations, following an Aug. 5 report about a possible pre-IPO raise. Reuters’ Sep. 25 account included a contemporaneous SK hynix statement that no specific plans had been confirmed. Comparing these statements, the reported bank pitches and tentative figures were new claims, not issuer confirmation.
observations.publication_time: 2026-09-04 (filing date); 2026-09-25 (Reuters report; displayed 12:47 PM, timezone not stated)
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The 6-K predates the reported pitch meetings. The new account remained an anonymous-source report and the company’s quoted position remained non-confirmation.

observations.observation: Reuters’ Sep. 25 story also referred to its earlier-this-month reporting that Solidigm was considering a U.S. NAND factory, with upstate New York a leading candidate. This is separate manufacturing context, not confirmation of an IPO.
observations.event_time: Earlier in September 2026; exact date not stated
observations.publication_time: 2026-09-25 (Reuters report; displayed 12:47 PM, timezone not stated)
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The article summarizes earlier Reuters coverage; this search did not verify a separate primary approval or a direct link between the factory consideration and any IPO.

observations.observation: The Business Times published a Reuters-attributed account on Sep. 26 at 09:06 AM, before the cutoff. It repeats the Reuters report rather than supplying an independently sourced account.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This is dissemination evidence only; it does not independently corroborate the anonymous-source claims.

gaps: No independently sourced contemporaneous report confirming the bank pitch meetings, valuation estimate or proceeds estimate was identified; the located early coverage was Reuters syndication or attribution.

Exact meeting dates, IPO venue, ownership/sale structure, valuation basis, financing terms and any binding underwriting or transaction decision were not established in the reviewed pre-cutoff sources.

The supplied Benzinga URL’s available page is marked updated after cutoff, and no dated pre-cutoff snapshot was verified; its article body therefore cannot be used to confirm the supplied source-message version.
